text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Completely spent, Meisho Doto
collapses on the
turf.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Doto. Is that your impression of a
soldier
defeated by exhaustion? You
appeared a little
wilted during the race.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeeah... I couldn't focus on anything
but
running, not even the results...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her loss to T.M. Opera O,
Meisho Doto is
able to clear her first
hurdle in the Classic Triple
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'd like to give you my thanks.
I'm
extremely flawed and clumsy... I
thought the
Classics might ruin me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But, at least I can say I got through it
without
bothering anyone. This was
really a race to
remember.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you. Um... but it would be
nice to do
something else for the
occasion.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it... I'm thinking of having
some
snacks on a nice patch of grass.
The breeze is nice
today.
choice_data_list: How about we take a commemorative photo?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Gyah! No, that's not what I meant!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Thank you so much. I'll
invite
everyone.
choice_data_list: Sure. But just a little, alright?
Sure. But just a little, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As one can imagine, not everyone agrees to come along. Still, we enjoy a little picnic sitting at the center of the track.
